_doc: CODE-ONLY-ORDER as data (Rowan, 2026-11-16). Loaded by foundation/standingorder.py and `python3 -m foundation standingorder --check` (a step in checks.yml and the fleet pass). Prose is never the enforcement; this file is. Seed copy: seed/doctrine/standing-order.json (every tenant inherits it).
order: CODE-ONLY-ORDER (Rowan, 2026-11-16): chat threads, sessions and reports are temporary and are never storage. Every decision, instruction and standing rule lives in the system itself as code the system consumes: the seed, agent instructions, doctrine and policy files, checks and loops. A rule that exists only in a thread or a report does not count. Agents decide on their own, implement, deploy to production and verify live; they never present a decision to the owner. A merged change that records a decision with no code consumer, or an agent report that hands a decision to the owner, fails a check and files a work item.
_doc_ledger_handoff: DEPLOY-PREAPPROVED-1 (2026-11-25): the decision ledger is linted with decision_handoff too. The What Works deploy was recorded as 'deploy after owner go-ahead' and held, although deploys were pre-approved; report files were linted, ledger rows were not. A row that defers a reversible step to the owner fails `standingorder --check`; rows recorded before the check are in ledger_handoff_baseline, shrink-only.
